nodes.name: cache_bridge.rs
nodes.summary: Bridges the in-memory event store to the on-disk/SQLite event cache: loading/saving session events, full-text search, per-event payload loading, and full-session import/export.

nodes.name: es_load_from_cache
nodes.summary: Tauri command that hydrates a session's in-memory event store from the persisted cache.

nodes.name: es_save_to_cache
nodes.summary: Tauri command that persists a session's current in-memory events to the cache.

nodes.name: cache_save_session_events
nodes.summary: Saves a session's events directly to the on-disk cache.

nodes.name: cache_load_session_events
nodes.summary: Loads a session's events directly from the on-disk cache.

nodes.name: cache_search_session_events
nodes.summary: Full-text searches a session's cached events for a query string.

nodes.name: cache_update_session_event
nodes.summary: Updates a single cached event record.

nodes.name: cache_get_session_event
nodes.summary: Retrieves a single cached event by id.

nodes.name: cache_load_event_payload
nodes.summary: Loads a specific field's payload for a cached event, used for lazy-loading large event bodies.

nodes.name: cache_save_full_session
nodes.summary: Persists a full session payload (events, specs, time range) to the cache in one operation.

nodes.name: cache_load_full_session
nodes.summary: Loads a full session payload (events, specs, time range) from the cache in one operation.

nodes.name: SessionEventSearchResult
nodes.summary: A single search-result hit: the matched event, its relevance rank, and a highlighted snippet.

nodes.name: FullSessionPayload
nodes.summary: Full serialized session payload: id, events, specs JSON, and time range, used for full-session cache save/load.

nodes.name: event_conversion.rs
nodes.summary: Converts between the persisted cached-event format and the in-memory SessionEvent model, including deduplication of tool calls, subagent-link backfilling, and compact-boundary event merging.

nodes.name: merge_loser_into_winner
nodes.summary: Merges fields from a duplicate ('loser') event into the canonical ('winner') event when deduplicating.

nodes.name: dedup_by_call_id
nodes.summary: Deduplicates events sharing the same tool-call id, merging duplicates into a single canonical event.

nodes.name: is_stream_transcript_event
nodes.summary: Checks whether an event is part of a raw streaming transcript pair.

nodes.name: dedup_stream_transcript_chunk_pairs
nodes.summary: Deduplicates matched streaming-transcript chunk pairs (start/end) into single events.

nodes.name: read_tool_inputs_by_call_id
nodes.summary: Reads persisted tool-call input arguments indexed by call id for a session.

nodes.name: merge_missing_args_from_tool_input
nodes.summary: Fills in missing tool-call arguments on an event from a previously recorded tool input.

nodes.name: backfill_tool_inputs_from_messages
nodes.summary: Backfills missing tool-call input arguments by scanning a session's message history.

nodes.name: backfill_subagent_links
nodes.summary: Backfills parent/child links between subagent session events based on heuristics over the event stream.

nodes.name: merge_compact_boundary_events
nodes.summary: Merges compact-boundary marker events (context-compaction points) into a session's event list.

nodes.name: read_compact_boundary_rows
nodes.summary: Reads raw compact-boundary rows from storage for a session.

nodes.name: compact_boundary_row_to_event
nodes.summary: Converts a raw compact-boundary storage row into a SessionEvent.

nodes.name: is_synthetic_turn_header_event
nodes.summary: Checks whether an event is a synthetic turn-header placeholder rather than real agent output.

nodes.name: is_synthetic_persistence_artifact
nodes.summary: Checks whether an event is a synthetic artifact created only for persistence bookkeeping, not real content.

nodes.name: normalize_event_record_value
nodes.summary: Normalizes a raw stored event JSON value into a consistent shape before conversion.

nodes.name: cached_event_to_session_event
nodes.summary: Converts a persisted CachedEvent row into the in-memory SessionEvent representation used by the frontend.

nodes.name: session_event_to_cached_event
nodes.summary: Converts an in-memory SessionEvent into the CachedEvent representation for persistence.

nodes.name: build_searchable_content
nodes.summary: Builds the flattened searchable text content for an event, used to populate full-text search indexes.

nodes.name: CompactBoundaryRow
nodes.summary: Raw storage row representing a context-compaction boundary: id, content, timestamp and token counts before/after.

nodes.name: extractors.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command handlers for extracting normalized per-event or windowed data payloads from a session's event store.

nodes.name: es_extract_event_data
nodes.summary: Tauri command that extracts normalized data for a single event by id.

nodes.name: es_extract_all_event_data
nodes.summary: Tauri command that extracts normalized data for all of a session's events.

nodes.name: es_extract_event_data_window
nodes.summary: Tauri command that extracts normalized data for a windowed page of a session's events.

nodes.name: history.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command handlers for querying session history: filtering/searching sessions, grouping, computing statistics, and resolving parent/child session relationships.

nodes.name: es_query_session_history
nodes.summary: Tauri command that queries session history records with filter criteria.

nodes.name: es_get_recent_sessions
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns the most recent sessions up to a limit.

nodes.name: es_group_sessions
nodes.summary: Tauri command that groups session history records by a given key.

nodes.name: es_compute_session_statistics
nodes.summary: Tauri command that computes aggregate statistics over session history.

nodes.name: clip_fields
nodes.summary: Clips a session record's status/timestamp fields for a lightweight summary view.

nodes.name: es_get_child_sessions
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns child (subagent) sessions for a given parent session id.

nodes.name: cli_child_session_records
nodes.summary: Resolves child-session records launched via CLI for a given parent session.

nodes.name: imported_child_session_records
nodes.summary: Resolves child-session records that were imported (not CLI-launched) for a given parent session.

nodes.name: es_get_parent_session
nodes.summary: Tauri command that resolves the parent session id for a given (subagent) session.

nodes.name: debug_seed_child_session
nodes.summary: Debug-only command that seeds a synthetic child session record for testing parent/child relationships.

nodes.name: ChildSessionView
nodes.summary: Frontend view of a child (subagent) session: the underlying record plus derived terminal/ended-at state.

nodes.name: ingestion.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command handlers that ingest and normalize raw CLI output chunks into session events.

nodes.name: es_ingest_chunks
nodes.summary: Tauri command that ingests a batch of raw CLI chunks into a session's event store.

nodes.name: es_process_chunks
nodes.summary: Processes raw CLI chunks into normalized session events without persisting.

nodes.name: es_normalize_chunk
nodes.summary: Normalizes a single raw CLI chunk into a session event shape.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Central Tauri command module for the event-pipeline event store: manages EventStoreState, snapshot/notify scheduling, retrying persistence, runtime-artifact session records, and re-exports all sibling command submodules.

nodes.name: prepare_loaded_events
nodes.summary: Prepares freshly-loaded raw events for a session (backfilling subagent prompts, etc.) before they enter the store.

nodes.name: resolve_session_id
nodes.summary: Resolves an explicit or ambient session id to operate on.

nodes.name: with_store_mut
nodes.summary: Runs a closure with mutable access to a session's EventStore, creating it if needed.

nodes.name: schedule_notify
nodes.summary: Schedules a debounced frontend notification that a session's events changed.

nodes.name: emit_snapshot
nodes.summary: Builds and emits a full event-store snapshot (sorted/filtered/compacted) to the frontend for a session.

nodes.name: pseudo_jitter_ms
nodes.summary: Computes a pseudo-random jitter delay in milliseconds used to stagger retry backoff.

nodes.name: save_events_retry
nodes.summary: Persists a batch of events with retry/backoff on failure.

nodes.name: persist_events_with_retry
nodes.summary: Persists events for a session with retry, wrapping save_events_retry.

nodes.name: persist_runtime_orgtrack_records_async
nodes.summary: Asynchronously persists runtime OrgTrack records derived from session events.

nodes.name: persist_runtime_orgtrack_records
nodes.summary: Persists runtime OrgTrack records derived from session events.

nodes.name: runtime_artifact_session_record
nodes.summary: Builds the runtime-artifact session record used for OrgTrack reporting from a session id.

nodes.name: push_events_to_session
nodes.summary: Core entry point that appends new events to a session's store, updates indexes, schedules notification and persists them.

nodes.name: update_spawning_tool_args_with_persist
nodes.summary: Updates spawning tool-call arguments for matching function names and persists the change.

nodes.name: update_tool_args_by_call_id_with_persist
nodes.summary: Updates a tool call's arguments by call id and persists the change.

nodes.name: EventStoreState
nodes.summary: Shared Tauri-managed state holding all active session EventStores, the session manager, and pending notification flags.

nodes.name: pagination.rs
nodes.summary: Tauri command handlers for paginated and filtered access to a session's events, including distinct-function counts.

nodes.name: es_paginate_events
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns a page of a session's in-memory events per a pagination request.

nodes.name: es_paginate_cached_events
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns a page of a session's cached (persisted) events.

nodes.name: es_count_matching_events
nodes.summary: Tauri command that counts a session's events matching given filters.

nodes.name: es_get_distinct_functions
nodes.summary: Tauri command that returns the distinct tool-call function names used in a session.
